Privacy Policy
 
 This Privacy Policy is updated on June 20, 2022. 
 
 Thank you for choosing the products and services of Shenzhen Snapmaker Technologies Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as “we” or “us”). We always value and respect your privacy. Therefore, the following privacy policy is formulated to state how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. 
 
Collection of Personal Information
 
 After obtaining your consent, we will only collect the personal information we need, including: 
 
 1. Machine name, model name, operating system status, and firmware version information, for purposes such as establishing telecommunication and updating firmware. 
 
 2. Connection status: hardware communication connection status and status of telecommunication with Snapmaker Luban, for the purpose of checking the connection status of the machine, and promptly reporting any exceptions (if any). 
 
 3. Screen operation information, for the purpose of recording your current location on the page and status, so as to help you quickly recover the operation to normal state when exceptions occur. 
 
 4. Firmware logs and error messages, which can be obtained by us only when you provide them on your own initiative. If you need to know your machine’s status, you can obtain the log file of the machine and send it to us by email, and we will check the machine’s status for you. 
 
 5. For the information we collect after you have chosen and expressly agreed to participate in the User Experience Improvement Program, please refer to the User Experience Improvement Program.
 
 6. We use Google Analytics (Google Analytics complies with the General Data Protection Regulation) on our websites. Due to the IP anonymization function, we will not and cannot independently obtain or track your IP address, data, etc. 
 
 You may also choose not to provide the personal information we request you to provide. However, if you choose not to provide such personal information, we will not be able to provide you with our products or services. 
 
Use of Personal Information
 
 We will only use your personal information if we have a lawful basis for doing so for the following purposes: 
 
 1. Understanding user needs and improving our services. We collect necessary personal information to support our services, and may use it for product or service improvement, fault analysis, problem diagnosis, notification of service changes, etc. 
 
 2. Participating in the interactive functions of services. 
 
 3. Legal compliance. 
 
 We may also use your personal information for other purposes with your consent. We will only retain personal information for a period of time that meets the above-mentioned purposes and complies with the requirements of applicable laws and regulations. 
 
Sharing of Personal Information
 
 We will not share your personal information with other companies, organizations, or individuals unless we obtain your express consent. We may share your personal information with a third party to meet legal and regulatory requirements, to respond to requests from regulatory agencies, courts, or government agencies, or to protect our legal rights. 


Protection of Personal Information
 
 We use administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information. However, please understand that due to technical limitations and possible malicious means, even if we do our best to strengthen security measures, there may be unexpected information security risks, and we will continue to improve these security measures and do our best to keep your personal information secure at all times. 
 
Changes to this Privacy Policy
 
 We reserve the right to modify or update this Privacy Policy at any time, and will inform you of any changes to this Privacy Policy through this interface. 
 
Contact Us
 
 If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@snapmaker.com
